skills.drover: Orchestrator: starts the runner, which runs Build → QA → Review and merges when green.
skills.drover-collect: Finds problems, verifies them, writes a findings doc for /to-spec and /to-tickets.
skills.ui-refine-loop: Critique → refine loop that polishes one page or component.
skills.visual: One HTML page: branch recap, plan, or codebase map with diagrams.
skills.git-sync: Commit per logical change, merge-pull, push without force, report.

skills.drover-build: Builder lane: worktree, smallest safe change, tests, draft PR.
skills.drover-qa: Tester lane: evidence, test-gap check, screenshots, or bounce to Build.
skills.drover-review: Reviewer lane: own hypotheses, remembers prior findings, merge gate.
skills.pr-security-review: Security pass on every PR diff; drover-qa runs it, findings fail QA.
